title: Traditional Japanese Temple Bell Tower, 1950s Japan B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot capturing a traditional Japanese temple compound, prominently featuring a wooden bell tower (shōrō) with a tiered, tiled irimoya roof and a skirted wooden base (hakamagoshi). The courtyard shows unpaved ground, adjacent wooden outbuildings with tiled roofs, and a utility pole in the background, characteristic of mid-20th-century post-war Japan.
